project.name: osgi/domains/systemd
project.description: The systemd domain: the typed unit/contract vocabulary plus the runtime-status readiness seam (systemd-contract), the systemd diagnostician (systemd-core), the cdk8s rendering of systemd units that systemd owns and contributes to the manifests domain as a carrier fragment (systemd-cdk8s-manifests), and the dbus-on-TCP edge that reads the live systemd (dbus-systemd-edge).
